summary:
What It Does: Players select either a white Moon suit or an orange flight suit astronaut and walk through a virtual NASA Space Museum. When they approach each large spacecraft exhibit, an interactive plaque opens with key dates, engineering feats, and discoveries from that mission. Featured Hardware & Science: 
• Mariner 4 (1965): First successful Mars flyby, returning 22 close-up images, measuring Mars's thin atmosphere (<1% of Earth's), and navigating via the star Canopus.
 • Surveyor 1 (1966): First U.S. soft landing on the Moon, proving lunar dust could safely support Apollo landers and transmitting 11,240 photos.
 • Lunar Orbiter 1 (1966): Mapped over 5 million sq km for Apollo landing sites, captured the first photo of Earth from lunar orbit, and processed film onboard.
 • Mariner 7 (1969): Survived a battery explosion five days before arrival to photograph Mars's south polar ice cap before entering silent solar orbit in 1970. How It Was Built: Created using Microsoft MakeCode.
details: Abandoned but not Forgotten is an interactive 2D pixel-art museum game designed to introduce school-age space enthusiasts to NASA’s pioneering 1960s spacecraft. Rather than treating retired probes as forgotten space hardware, the game lets young players walk through a virtual museum, inspect each spacecraft up close, and discover how these early missions paved the way for modern space exploration.
